##### Project general facts

Sun Hills Lakeside is a private resort residential complex comprising 3 buildings of 7 floors each, totalling 401 units with custom finishing across studio, 1-bedroom, 2-bedroom, and 3-bedroom configurations. The facades feature a bionic architectural design crafted from natural and durable materials with cascading vertical greenery, architectural lighting, and panoramic glazing with terraces in every unit. Ground floor units have direct pool access and private landscaped areas, while upper-floor residences offer panoramic views of the surrounding tropical landscape and lagoon.

Residents will benefit from a curated range of amenities designed to support both relaxation and active living. The complex features three heated swimming pools including rooftop pools and a dedicated children's pool, plus an aqua club, an open-air cinema, and rooftop lounge terraces with panoramic views over the lagoon. The Khabib Gym training center provides personal and group training, functional zones, jiu-jitsu, Muay Thai, boxing, and recovery spaces, complemented by a separate sports and wellness facility with a fully equipped fitness gym, yoga, pilates, stretching studios, and meditation areas. A world-class spa with sauna, hammam, massage rooms, and recovery suites, a full-service restaurant, children's game center with activity zones and professional animators, coworking areas with meeting rooms, and underground parking with EV charging stations and a car wash complete the infrastructure.

Interiors are delivered with a focus on contemporary elegance and functionality. Units are delivered with custom finishing, featuring a contemporary interior scheme with marble-effect splashbacks and worktops in the kitchen, integrated appliances including a Samsung microwave, washer-dryer, and black-finish cabinetry in upper and lower configurations. Bedrooms are finished with upholstered wall paneling in neutral tones, timber veneer accent panels, patterned area rugs, and flanking bedside lighting in a hotel-style layout.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Located on the northwest coast of Phuket, Bang Tao is one of the island’s most sought-after coastal destinations, known for its long stretch of pristine beach and relaxed upscale atmosphere. The area is home to the renowned Laguna Phuket — a fully integrated resort community featuring luxury hotels, golf courses, spas, and high-end residences. Bang Tao Beach itself spans nearly 6 kilometers, offering a quieter alternative to the more vibrant tourist hubs while still maintaining a sophisticated lifestyle appeal. 

The district is well-developed with a strong infrastructure, providing residents and visitors with easy access to lifestyle amenities. Within minutes, you’ll find premium dining venues, beach clubs, and shopping destinations such as Boat Avenue and Porto de Phuket. The area seamlessly blends leisure and convenience, with international schools, wellness centers, and supermarkets all nearby, making it ideal for both short-term stays and long-term living.

Bang Tao also benefits from excellent connectivity. Phuket International Airport is approximately a 20 minute drive away, ensuring easy international access. The project offers shuttle buses to the beach and key infrastructure points. Its strategic location allows quick connections to neighboring areas such as Surin and Kamala, while still preserving a sense of privacy and exclusivity — making Bang Tao a prime choice for investors and homeowners seeking a balance of tranquility and vibrant coastal living.
